_meta.name: sem-mean-structure-and-groups
_meta.description: The three-factor CFA of brand_survey.pulse (quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3, value =~ v1 + v2 + v3, service =~ s1 + s2 + s3) on the lavaan path, then across the two survey waves as ONE joint multi-group fit. means sets meanstructure: lavaan's ML fit with free intercepts (x ~1 rows), Wald ci_lower / ci_upper columns and implied_means / observed_means. configural adds group wave: every parameter free per wave, estimate rows keyed [level] lval op rval with vectors.group and vectors.label, per-wave auxiliaries (implied_covariance.wave1, observed_means.wave2, ...) and joint scalars plus chi2_group_<level> / n_group_<level>. scalar holds loadings and intercepts equal (group_equal), which frees the latent means of wave2 (wave1, the group_reference, stays 0): the [wave2] value ~1 and [wave2] service ~1 rows are each factor's shift in marker units. The fixture plants that shift (value down about 0.24, service up about 0.525, quality unchanged) and the scalar step recovers it. partial frees the v2 intercept again (group_partial v2~1). Compare chi2, dof, cfi and rmsea from configural to scalar to read measurement invariance. Streamable and mergeable: each wave's means and covariance merge on their own.
